**A CURIOUS q-ANALOGUE OF HERMITE POLYNOMIALS**

*JOHANN CIGLER AND JIANG ZENG*

19 pp, 8 sections.

**Abstract.** Two well-known q-Hermite polynomials are the continuous and discrete q-Hermite polynomials. In this paper we consider a new family of q-Hermite polynomials and prove several curious properties about these polynomials. One st riking property is the connection with q-Fibonacci and q-Lucas polynomials. The latter relation yields a generaliz ation of the Touchard-Riordan formula.
